0022600128.text: The Celtics (2-1) host the Nets (0-3) as they begin a stretch of home games, having won their last two and sitting second in the Atlantic, half a game back, and fifth in the East. Brooklyn is on a three-game losing streak, 2.5 games out of fifth in the Atlantic and 14th in the East. The teams have not met yet this season, but Boston won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 148-111 win in Boston on February 27, 2026.
